scope: Replay-exclusive closure after shared batch 01: job finalization, GameMessage vector copying, path expression materialization, Catmull-Rom camera math, and camera setters

applied.name: ReplayMatchSetup_GetPlayerDisconnectFlag
applied.evidence: Bounds-checks one of eight replay match/player slots and returns its stored disconnect/retention flag.

applied.name: ReplayJobPair_Reset
applied.evidence: Resets two adjacent 0xB24-byte replay job handles and initializes the pair controller state and completion flags.

applied.name: ReplayJobPair_IsProcessing
applied.evidence: Returns true for pair-controller states 2 through 5, the active processing/finalization interval.

applied.name: UnicodeStringConcatExpr3_Init
applied.evidence: Builds the three-pointer expression used to concatenate replay directory, basename, and extension without copying them yet.

applied.name: UnicodeStringConcatExpr_Materialize
applied.evidence: Evaluates a Unicode-string concatenation expression into the output string and releases the expression's temporary state.

applied.name: GameMessageVector_CopyCtor
applied.evidence: Allocates exact capacity for the source vector and deep-copies every 132-byte GameMessage into the destination.

applied.name: CatmullRom_InterpolateScalar
applied.evidence: Evaluates the canonical uniform Catmull-Rom cubic polynomial for four scalar samples and interpolation parameter t.

applied.name: Vector3_CatmullRomInterpolate
applied.evidence: Applies CatmullRom_InterpolateScalar independently to three vector components.

applied.name: Vector4_CatmullRomInterpolate
applied.evidence: Applies CatmullRom_InterpolateScalar independently to four quaternion/vector components.

applied.name: Camera_SetPosition
applied.evidence: Copies a three-float position to camera offsets 0x0C..0x14 and marks the transform dirty.

applied.name: Camera_SetRotationQuaternion
applied.evidence: Copies a four-float rotation quaternion to camera offsets 0x18..0x24 and marks the transform dirty.

applied.name: KWReplayJob_FinalizeOutput
applied.evidence: Finalizes a file-backed replay immediately or emits the archive endmode record before transitioning the replay job to terminal state.
